messages:
Jordan W.: FYI: several interviewers for the backend panel reported they didn't receive the standardized scorecard PDF in their calendar invites this morning. Noticed across two jobs.
Priya S.: I saw this too. The ATS shows "delivered" but the attachment URL 403s when accessed.
Alex (recruiter): Candidates affected: C-9981 (09:30), C-9982 (10:45), C-9989 (14:00). I pasted the rubric into the calendar for 14:00 but others still missing.
ops-bot: [automated] webhook: /attachments/attach -> 403 Forbidden for tenant recruiting-nyc (attempt 1).
Jordan W.: Any recent changes to the S3 presign policy or token rotation?
Liam T.: Ops rolled a credential rotation yesterday for the assets service. Presign expiry was tightened from 1h to 10m as a security hardening. Looks like some calendar invites are created earlier than the panel and presigned links expired by delivery time.
Priya S.: That explains it. For the immediate term, can we: 1) regenerate presigns for the affected attachments and re-attach, 2) add a fallback to embed the scorecard text in the invite if presign fails?
Alex (recruiter): please prioritize regenerate for C-9981 and C-9982, they start in <90m.
Liam T.: On it. I'll run a quick backfill to regenerate presigned URLs for those IDs and patch the invites. Will capture before/after response codes.
ops-bot: [automated] runbook triggered: backfill-presign-attachments for tenant recruiting-nyc by Liam T.
Liam T.: Backfill results: C-9981 -> presign regenerated -> 200 -> attachment reattached; C-9982 -> presign regenerated -> 200 -> reattached; C-9989 -> presign expired again on retry (candidate rescheduled) so recruiter pasted inline.
Jordan W.: Thanks. Long-term we should: a) increase presign TTL for calendar attachments to 6h (or make it configurable per-tenant), b) add healthcheck alert for assets_service_presign_403_rate > 1 in 15m, c) update interviewer onboarding doc to mention manual fallback.
Priya S.: +1. Also we should consider attaching the non-sensitive PDF copy directly to the ATS instead of relying on presign links where possible.
Alex (recruiter): I can draft a short guide for recruiters with the manual fallback steps and tips on scheduling so presign window covers delivery.
Liam T.: I opened PR: github.com/redwood/assets-service/pull/512 -> add per-tenant presign TTL + metrics for presign forbidden responses.
ops-bot: [automated] alert created: assets_service_presign_403_rate > 1 in 15m -> notify #people-ops and page oncall-assets.
